text:
Kawaguchiko day booked, but the forecast says cloud?
Don't cancel yet.
Here's how we'd decide 👇

👀 Full guide 👉 https://japanbystation.com/kawaguchiko-cloudy-fuji-forecast

🔎 The evening before
Check the forecast first.
Then check the live Fuji cameras:
search "Fujisan Watcher" by Yamanashi Tourism.
They show the real cloud over Fuji, right now.

🅰️ Move the date (if you can)
🎫 JR East lets you change an unused ticket
once, for free. A reserved seat must be
changed before the train leaves.
🚌 Highway buses are stricter.
You cancel and rebook, and fees vary.
Day buses: cancel by 17:00 the day before.
🏨 The lakeside hotel we checked
cancels free until the day before.

🅱️ Go anyway
🎨 Visit the Itchiku Kubota Art Museum:
dyed kimono landscapes in a lava-stone garden.
¥1,500, open 10:00 to 16:30 in winter.
About 20 minutes by Red Line bus.
🍲 Then warm up with hoto noodles at Hoto Fudo.
Open 11:00 to 19:00 daily, ¥1,210 a bowl.

🅲 Stay the night
🌅 An overnight gives you two chances to see Fuji.
The 2-day bus pass is ¥2,000,
only ¥500 more than one day.

✅ Our take
Spare day and refundable bookings? Move it.
No spare day? Go, with the museum and hoto.
Night already booked? Keep it,
and check the cameras when you wake up.

👉 Matcha by a garden waterfall, plus the full plan:
